description: Extract image/media asset URLs from indexed markdown text. Use only when the user asks for product images, media files, visual assets, screenshots, WordPress uploads, or image evidence. For textual questions about extracted page content, use search_content instead. Returns asset URLs plus the real page URL where each asset appeared.

domain.description: Optional exact domain filter, for example physio-relax.de.

query.description: Optional topic, product, filename, or asset context to search before extracting assets. Defaults to image/product-oriented search.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

top.description: Maximum number of chunks to inspect for assets. Defaults to at least 10.

url.description: Optional exact crawled page URL filter.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

name: find_content_assets
title: Find Content Assets
